```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    SELECT
        b.assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS qty
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
      AND b.assembly_id = (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'HB-T721')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        b.assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        bt.qty * b.per_assembly_qty
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    JOIN bom_tree bt ON b.assembly_id = bt.component_id
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bt.component_id
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND p.make_flag = true
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bt.qty), 0) AS total_qty
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bt.component_id
WHERE p.product_number = 'MS-0253';
```

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Recursive BOM explosion for a given top-level product, as of 2025-06-30

    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.top_id, e.top_number,
           b.component_id, e.qty * b.per_assembly_qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN product c ON c.product_id = e.component_id AND c.make_flag = TRUE
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = e.component_id
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'

),

WITH RECURSIVE

    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = e.component_id
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2021-06-08'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2021-06-08' <= b.end_date)
),
-- total qty of MS-2341 per unit of FR-R38B-62 on 2021-06-08
earlier AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.qty), 0) AS total
    FROM explode e
    JOIN product root ON root.product_id = e.assembly_id
    JOIN product comp ON comp.product_id = e.component_id
    WHERE root.product_number = 'FR-R38B-62'
      AND comp.product_number = 'MS-2341'
),
-- BOM explosion for current date
explode_cur AS (
    SELECT
        b.assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS qty,
        b.bom_level
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        e.assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        e.qty * b.per_assembly_qty,
        b.bom_level
    FROM explode_cur e
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = e.component_id AND p.make_flag = TRUE
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = e.component_id
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
),
current_qty AS (

explosion AS (
    -- Base: the sold product itself (direct units)
    SELECT l.order_id, l.order_date, p.product_number AS code, CAST(l.order_qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty

    FROM explosion e
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = e.code
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = e.code
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND c.valid_from <= e.order_date
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= c.valid_to)
)

WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
  SELECT parent_code, child_code, qty, valid_from, valid_to, 1 AS lvl
  FROM u_composition
  WHERE parent_code = 'BK-M18S-44'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.parent_code, c.child_code, c.qty, c.valid_from, c.valid_to, b.lvl + 1
  FROM u_composition c
  JOIN bom b ON c.parent_code = b.child_code
  JOIN product p ON p.product_number = b.child_code
  WHERE p.make_flag = true
),
paths AS (
  SELECT child_code, qty, valid_from, valid_to, lvl
  FROM bom
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.child_code, p.qty * b.qty, 
         CASE WHEN p.valid_from > b.valid_from THEN p.valid_from ELSE b.valid_from END,
         CASE WHEN p.valid_to IS NULL OR b.valid_to IS NULL THEN NULL
              WHEN p.valid_to < b.valid_to THEN p.valid_to ELSE b.valid_to END,
         p.lvl + b.lvl
  FROM paths p
  JOIN bom b ON b.parent_code = p.child_code
  JOIN product pr ON pr.product_number = p.child_code
  WHERE pr.make_flag = true
),
qty_at AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN valid_from <= DATE '2021-08-10' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2021-08-10' <= valid_to) THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS earlier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= valid_to) THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS current
  FROM paths
  WHERE child_code = 'SH-4562'
)
SELECT COALESCE(current,0) - COALESCE(earlier,0) AS change
FROM qty_at;

WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    SELECT parent_code, child_code, qty, valid_from, valid_to
    FROM u_composition
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.parent_code, c.child_code, b.qty * c.qty, 
           GREATEST(b.valid_from, c.valid_from),
           CASE WHEN b.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
                WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN b.valid_to
                ELSE LEAST(b.valid_to, c.valid_to) END
    FROM bom b
    JOIN u_composition c ON b.child_code = c.parent_code
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = c.parent_code AND p.make_flag = true
)
SELECT SUM(demand) AS total_demand
FROM (
    -- units sold directly
    SELECT SUM(sol.order_qty) AS demand
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON st.territory_id = so.territory_id
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = sol.product_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Central'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM so.order_date) = 2025
      AND p.product_number = 'MS-2348'
    UNION ALL
    -- units included at any level
    SELECT SUM(sol.order_qty * b.qty) AS demand
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON st.territory_id = so.territory_id
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = sol.product_id
    JOIN bom b ON b.parent_code = p.product_number AND b.child_code = 'MS-2348'
    WHERE st.name = 'Central'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM so.order_date) = 2025
      AND b.valid_from <= so.order_date
      AND (b.valid_to IS NULL OR so.order_date <= b.valid_to)
) t;

explosion AS (

    FROM lines l
    UNION ALL

    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = e.item_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= e.order_date
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= c.valid_to)
)
